evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies block-index loading in 'src/node/blockstorage.cpp' and candidate chain selection in 'src/validation.cpp'.
rationale: Prevents an unrecoverable assertion crash on startup during AssumeUTXO background sync. If a node restarts while holding the snapshot block without its ancestors, 'LoadBlockIndex()' causes 'FindMostWorkChain()' to abort on every boot, forcing a full '-reindex' that destroys the snapshot chainstate.
